user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results within ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: Crawling web content to show results in ChatGPT search features.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of web pages submitted as ads.
user_agents.scope: Visits landing pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for training OpenAI generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Crawling web content for generative AI foundation model training.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform actions triggered by user requests in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated web visits and interactions via GPT Actions.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content that could potentially contribute to AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Public web content gathered to enhance generative AI model utility and safety.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites to retrieve content at user direction.
user_agents.scope: Web content retrieved in response to user-initiated queries to Claude.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Online content analyzed specifically to enhance the relevance and accuracy of search responses.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Find information to build Google search indexes and perform crawls.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, and Google News.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawl images for Google Search and image-related features.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and image features in Google Search.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl videos for Google Search and video-related features.
user_agents.scope: Affects video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for the Google News product.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google News, news.google.com, and the Google News app.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: Affects all surfaces of Google Shopping and the Shopping tab in Google Search.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Perform diagnostic crawls for Search testing tools.
user_agents.scope: Affects Rich Result Test and Search Console URL inspection tools.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for product teams and internal research and development.
user_agents.scope: Used by various product teams for fetching publicly accessible content from sites.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible image URLs for Google product teams.
user_agents.scope: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching publicly accessible image URLs.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible video URLs for Google product teams.
user_agents.scope: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching publicly accessible video URLs.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content requested by site owners for Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Affects crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Control content usage for training and grounding Gemini models.
user_agents.scope: Controls content usage for Gemini model training and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index web data automatically to deliver search experience.
user_agents.scope: Content indexing and web data collection.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index web information in response to user requests.
user_agents.scope: User-triggered web fetching and searching.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search technology and context display across Apple products.
user_agents.scope: Crawls and renders web content across the web for search indexing and AI answers.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls data usage for training Apple foundation models powering generative AI.
user_agents.scope: Does not crawl webpages; determines how data crawled by Applebot is used.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls registered podcast content for Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawl app or website content shared on Meta apps.
user_agents.scope: Links shared on Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt; may bypass for security checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Web content to enhance Meta AI relevance and accuracy.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Improve advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content for advertising use cases.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Train foundation AI models or improve products by indexing content.
user_agents.scope: Web content for AI training and product indexing.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetch individual links at user request and evaluate agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: User-requested links and agentic website navigation.

user_agents.name: Bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content for Bing search indexing and AI features.
user_agents.scope: Standard web crawling across public internet content for Bing and Microsoft Copilot.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: Bingbot.

user_agents.name: BingPreview
user_agents.purpose: Generates page snapshots and previews in real time.
user_agents.scope: On-demand page retrieval for generating rich previews and snapshots.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: BingPreview.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves Amazon products and services and trains Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Host-level web crawling to provide accurate customer information and train AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives in robots.txt or noarchive/noindex robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services like Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Crawls content for search eligibility; excludes generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives in robots.txt or noindex/none robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Fetches live information from the web to support user queries.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated live web fetching; does not crawl for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives due to user initiation.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to provide an open dataset for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Extracts crawl candidates to fetch randomly selected web content samples.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow CCBot in robots.txt or join the opt-out registry.
